title: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
summary_raw: Nvidia's new data engine Flora labels one hour of robot video for 72 cents instead of $88 with GPT-6 Astra, while scoring slightly higher on quality. The open system, built on three fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models, catches errors in robot actions far more reliably than any competitor but sometimes falls short on descriptive accuracy. Nvidia is positioning Flora as a key piece of its strategy to control the entire robotics value chain. title: Ex-Google CEO Eric Schmidt calls OpenAI and Anthropic modern colonial trading companies
summary_raw: In Foreign Affairs, historian Niall Ferguson, researcher Lisa Klaassen, and former Google CEO Eric Schmidt cast the US and China as AI empires and every other country as a dependency. The race won't be decided by breakthroughs but by who can bankroll it. US corporations alone plan to spend more than $600 billion in 2026. Yet mounting debt, protests against data centers, and a potential chip crisis over Taiwan could stall both superpowers. summary_raw: OpenAI is poaching Anthropic's customers with steep discounts. Companies like Rippling, Replit, and DataCamp say they've cut AI costs by up to 90 percent after switching. title: OpenMobile-2 proves open-source smartphone agents can rival proprietary models
summary_raw: Smartphone agents don't get better by processing more data. They improve by training on as many different apps as possible. The researchers behind OpenMobile-2 built an open training environment with more than 110 applications, including 35 replicas of popular apps. On real Android devices, their model scores highest among open agents, the authors say. title: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers say they were never told what they actually leaked
summary_raw: The three OpenAI safety researchers who were fired, Tomek Korbak, Mikita Balesni, and Jasmine Wang, are publicly pushing back against allegations from their former employer. They deny sharing confidential information and see a connection to their advocacy for AI systems that are easier to scrutinize. The researchers say OpenAI never told them in writing which information they allegedly mishandled. title: AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth
summary_raw: A three-month field experiment with 133 patent attorneys shows that AI boosts immediate performance, with junior lawyers gaining the most.
